4. Business Rules & Validation Notes Report-module acceptance criteria
Derived Logic
  • Calibration status is derived from next calibration due date.
  • Due Soon threshold can be configured by admin, e.g. 30/60/90 days.
  • Division name is resolved through section/division master.
Status Legend
VALIDDUE_SOONOVERDUEIN_PROGRESSCOMPLETEDVERIFIED_CLOSED
Approval Rule
Acceptable when every active equipment has due date, division, status and traceable equipment ID.
